purpose: Test whether a causal walk-forward meta-selector can identify which already-defined primary setups are worth taking, while explicitly allowing PASS/cash decisions.

method_change.selector_unit: one proposed portfolio setup for one next-open to next-open holding period

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

execution.execution: next UTC daily open after completed signal day
execution.rebalance: daily including transitions to and from cash

meta_trend_acceleration_5d.provenance: New meta-selection hypothesis using the unchanged Sprint 11 ungated trend-acceleration parent; Sprint 7/8/11 IDs remain closed.
meta_trend_acceleration_5d.score: sum of the most recent 5 completed close-to-close returns minus the preceding non-overlapping 5 completed returns
meta_trend_acceleration_5d.direction: long highest two scores and short lowest two
meta_trend_acceleration_5d.primary_state_gate: BTC Wilder ADX14 >= 25 at the completed signal close
meta_trend_acceleration_5d.primary_is_active: state gate true and at least six finite cross-sectional scores

meta_low_skew_90d.provenance: New meta-selection hypothesis using the unchanged Sprint 11 ungated 90-day low-skew parent; Sprint 10/11 IDs remain closed.
meta_low_skew_90d.score: negative unbiased sample skewness of the most recent 90 completed close-to-close daily returns
meta_low_skew_90d.direction: long highest two negative-skew scores and short lowest two
meta_low_skew_90d.primary_is_active: at least six finite cross-sectional scores

meta_funding_carry_14d.provenance: New meta-selection hypothesis using the unchanged Sprint 11 ungated 14-day funding-carry parent; Sprint 9/11 IDs remain closed.
meta_funding_carry_14d.score: negative realized funding burden per calendar day over the strictly prior 14 calendar days
meta_funding_carry_14d.direction: long highest two carry scores and short lowest two
meta_funding_carry_14d.primary_is_active: at least six finite cross-sectional scores

meta_features.feature_timing: All price features end at the completed signal close. Funding feature uses settlements timestamped strictly before the execution open.
meta_features.missing_feature_rule: PASS; setup is not scored until all frozen features are finite.

meta_label.definition: Whether the proposed primary setup would have produced positive standalone next-open to next-open net PnL after realized funding and a conservative full cash-to-position-to-cash round trip at baseline transaction costs.
meta_label.why_standalone: Makes each historical setup label independent of which neighboring setups the meta-selector happened to accept.

walk_forward_model.refit: for every new eligible primary setup using only the latest 80 strictly prior labeled primary setups

controls.ungated_parent: take every eligible primary setup unchanged
controls.same_meta_decisions_reversed_primary: apply the exact frozen TRADE/PASS decisions to the exact reversed cross-sectional primary ranking
controls.anti_meta_diagnostic: diagnostic only: take eligible setups with predicted positive probability <= 0.40
controls.accepted_vs_rejected_setup_labels: diagnostic comparison of standalone realized setup returns

d0_research_candidate_gate.selection: Each family has one frozen meta model and one frozen 0.60 acceptance threshold. No alternative threshold, model, feature subset or hyperparameter may be substituted after results.

evidence_boundary.research_candidate_means: deserves freeze and hostile validation, not established edge
evidence_boundary.required_path_after_D0: candidate freeze -> independent reproduction -> D2 source replication -> D3 non-overlapping temporal -> D4 prospective shadow
